login.ldap_indisponivel: the directory did not answer; try the local sign-in or tell the administrator
login.ldap_login_local: a local account with this login already exists; talk to the administrator
login.ldap_sem_configuracao: directory sign-in is not configured for this tenant
login.ldap_sem_grupo: no directory group is mapped to a profile of this platform; talk to the administrator
login.muitas_tentativas: too many attempts; wait a minute
login.so_externo: this tenant signs in only through the organization login
mapa.anotacao_apagar_confirma: Delete this annotation? This cannot be undone.
mapa.anotacao_inexistente: annotation not found or no permission
mapa.anotacao_sem_alvo: turn the mode on and click a feature to read and write annotations
mapa.anotacao_sem_grupo: you have no group to comment in (create one in /grupos)
mapa.anotacao_so_autor: only the author edits or deletes the annotation
mapa.anotacao_vazio: no annotation on this feature yet
mapa.atalho_fechar: close the panel or the table
mapa.atalhos_ajuda: with focus outside a text field; Esc closes the open panel
mapa.busca_ajuda: address, or a coordinate such as -23.49350, -46.59300
mapa.desenho_circulo_polo: circle centered beyond ±85° latitude (degenerate on the map)
mapa.desenho_erro_biblioteca: drawing library did not load (terra-draw missing)
mapa.desenho_raio_invalido: invalid radius (must be > 0 and up to 2,000,000 m)
mapa.desenho_salvo: drawing saved in the map document
mapa.erro_biblioteca: map library did not load (MapLibre or PMTiles missing)
mapa.exportar_crs: EPSG code of the output CRS
mapa.exportar_sem_camada: turn a layer on to export
mapa.exportar_so_vista: only the features in the current view
mapa.exportar_validade: the link is valid for {dias} days
mapa.impressao_ajuda: PNG and PDF come with title, scale, north arrow, legend and attribution
mapa.medicao_ajuda: click the map to place vertices; double-click finishes
mapa.pacote_ajuda: the zip exported as a map package comes back as a new map with the layers recreated in this tenant
mapa.pacote_camada_invalida: a layer of the package could not be loaded: {mensagem}
mapa.pacote_enviando: uploading the package ({mb} MB) and recreating the layers
mapa.sem_camadas: publish a layer in Content (New item > File) and it shows up here to turn on
motor.ajuda: nested-grid multicriteria engine: a study area, factors with declared scale and chosen weight, a coarse grid (macro) and refinement (micro) only where the macro approved
motor.amostras_ajuda: paste "lon, lat, value" lines or generate a 6×6 grid with a constant value over the area
motor.amostras_sem_area: choose a study area to generate the grid
motor.amostras_texto: samples, one per line: longitude, latitude, value
motor.area_apagar_confirma: Delete the study area "{nome}" and all its runs?
motor.area_bbox_invalido: invalid rectangle: four numbers west, south, east, north, with west < east and south < north
motor.area_da_vista_ajuda: empty = the map's visible rectangle right now; or west, south, east, north in degrees
motor.area_vazio: no study area yet; frame the map on the region and create one from the view
motor.celula_cobertura: coverage {pct}% of the weight with data
motor.fator_apagar_confirma: Delete the factor "{nome}" and its samples?
motor.fator_resolucao_ajuda: DECLARED resolution of the source data; the report compares it with the grid
motor.fator_resolucao_invalida: the native scale must be greater than zero
motor.fatores_vazio: no factor yet; create one with the source's native scale and load samples
motor.rel_economia: {pct}% of the possible cells were not computed (outside the approved regions)
motor.rel_grosseira_explica: the source ({fonte} m) is coarser than the grid ({grade} m): this cell's score comes from the source block, not from data of its own
motor.resolucao_invalida: the resolution must be greater than zero
motor.sem_area: choose or create a study area
nav.acervo_desc: the house's data sources with a written license and provenance record; add to the catalog
nav.admin_desc: tenant summary: users, groups, roles, tokens, quotas, directory, holdings and log
nav.categorias_desc: the tenant's category tree: edit, reorder and import ISO 19115 or INSPIRE
nav.conexoes_desc: connections to external services: health, history and published layers with provenance
nav.conta_desc: details, password, second factor, sessions and invitations
nav.conteudo_desc: item catalog: layers, maps, apps, files; folders, search and sharing
nav.estilo_guia_desc: design system tokens and components, rendered live
nav.geocodificar_desc: address to coordinate and coordinate to address over IBGE's CNEFE, with score and match type
nav.importacoes_desc: an uploaded file becomes a vector layer: inspection, proposal to review and load
nav.inquilinos_desc: superadmin console: create, suspend, reactivate and delete platform tenants
nav.mapa_desc: local basemap in MapLibre, layers and navigation
nav.organizacao_desc: name, visual identity, default map, quotas and password/2FA policy of the tenant
nav.tokens_desc: service tokens with scope, restriction and expiry
nav.uploads_desc: upload large files with resume; becomes a catalog item
nav.usuarios_desc: tenant members: create, edit, disable, reset password
org.arquivo_apagar_confirma: Delete object {sha}…? Whatever references it stops finding it.
org.arquivo_classe_ajuda: lowercase letters, digits and underscore; groups the objects (objeto, anexo, org_logo)
org.arquivo_classe_invalida: invalid class: lowercase letters, digits and underscore, up to 40
org.arquivo_recusado: content refused: the bytes do not match the declared type (detected {tipo})
org.arquivo_sem_token: uploading requires creating a service token (privilege tokens.gerar)
org.arquivos_ajuda: generic tenant objects in storage (logo, attachments, exports); the upload uses a one-day service token created and revoked here
org.arquivos_varredura: {objetos} objects in storage, {linhas} records; {sem_linha} without record, {sem_objeto} without object
org.dominios_email: allowed e-mail domains (one per line; empty = any)
org.erro_carregar: could not load the organization settings
org.exigir_2fa: require a second factor (2FA) from every member
org.logo_ajuda: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WEBP, up to 1 MB; the image is fitted to a 300×300 frame
org.mapa_ajuda: center, zoom and basemap a new map opens with in this tenant
org.seguranca_ajuda: the same policy /conta already shows to each member when changing the password (tenant.config.auth)
org.senha_expira_dias: password expires in N days (0 = never)
org.senha_historico: do not repeat the last N passwords
papeis.nao_tem_privilegio: your session does not have this privilege; it cannot grant it
papeis.perfil_texto: the profile is the ceiling: a custom role can only contain privileges from this set.
papeis.privilegios_ajuda: the minimum profile is computed by the server; an administrative privilege requires the administrator profile; you only grant what your session has
papeis.vazio: no custom role; the four profiles act as default roles
plataforma.apagar_texto: Delete {slug} with {n} users, data, tokens and log? There is no trash.
plataforma.criado_aviso: save the password now: it is not shown again nor stored in clear text
plataforma.criado_resumo: tenant {slug} created; administrator {login} with the temporary password below
plataforma.erro_plataforma_propria: the platform tenant cannot be suspended or deleted
plataforma.negado: this screen belongs to the superadmin of the platform tenant; your session does not have that role
plataforma.novo_ajuda: creates the tenant with its first administrator; the temporary password is shown once and the administrator changes it on first access
plataforma.slug_ajuda: lowercase, digits and hyphen, 2 to 39 characters; becomes the short sign-in address
plataforma.slug_existente: a tenant with this identifier already exists
plataforma.slug_invalido: invalid identifier: lowercase, digits and hyphen, 2 to 39 characters
plataforma.subtitulo: operator console: tenants of this installation
plataforma.suspender_texto: Suspend {slug}? Nobody from it can sign in until reactivation.
redefinir_senha.concluido: Password changed. You can sign in now.
redefinir_senha.invalido: this link does not exist or can no longer be used
redefinir_senha.solicitado: If an account exists with that e-mail, a link was sent. Check your inbox.
redefinir_senha.solicitar_ajuda: enter the tenant and the registered e-mail; if an account exists with that e-mail, we will send a link
rotas.clique_no_mapa_texto: the next click on the map sets: {ponto}
rotas.erro_isocrona_vazia: fewer than 3 reachable points in {minutos} min: increase the time or move the starting point
rotas.erro_matriz_grande: {n} × {m} pairs exceed the cap of {teto} per request; reduce origins or destinations
rotas.erro_osrm: the routing service did not answer: {erro}
rotas.exemplo_ponto: longitude, latitude (e.g. -46.53300, -23.46280) or mark on the map
rotas.falta_matriz: add at least one origin and one destination
rotas.falta_origem_destino: mark the origin and the destination
rotas.minutos_invalidos: minutes must be greater than zero
rotas.ponto_invalido: invalid coordinate: use longitude, latitude in decimal degrees
rotas.vazio: choose the calculation type, mark the points on the map (or type the coordinates) and calculate; the result goes to the map and to this panel
selecao.ajuda_like: % stands for any text; without % it searches anywhere
selecao.camada_ajuda: only hosted layers turned on in the map appear here
selecao.desenho_ajuda: draw a polygon, rectangle, line or point in the Drawing panel and pick it here
selecao.distancia_invalida: distance must be greater than zero
selecao.erro_campo: field {campo} is not in the layer's allow list
selecao.erro_sem_tabela: this layer is not hosted: there is no table to query
selecao.filtrar_mapa: filter the layer on the map
selecao.filtro_aplicado: filter applied: only the {n} selected features stay visible
selecao.filtro_aplicado_amostra: filter applied with the sample of {n} features; the full selection is larger
selecao.filtro_removido: filter removed; the whole layer is back
selecao.nota: the selection is temporary until saved; the SQL shown is what the server ran
selecao.sem_camada: turn on a hosted layer in the Layers panel to select
selecao.sem_desenho: no drawn feature; draw one in the Drawing panel
selecao.truncado: the server returned a sample of {amostra} identifiers; the count is the total
selecao.valor_booleano: field {campo} is boolean; type yes or no
selecao.valor_numerico: field {campo} is numeric; type a number
senha.curta: the password needs at least {n} characters
senha.nao_atende: does not meet the rule yet
senha.nao_atende_regra: the password does not meet the rule: {regra}
senha.regra_base: at least {n} characters, with a letter and a digit
senha.regra_generica: at least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit; the organization may require more
senha.trocada: password changed; the other sessions were ended
smtp.ajuda: member invitations, password resets and notices go out through this server; without SMTP those flows fall back to the manual path (temporary password shown to the admin)
smtp.erro_carregar: could not load the SMTP settings
smtp.host_ajuda: empty removes this tenant's SMTP and goes back to the installation's (if any)
smtp.origem_nenhum: no SMTP configured — manual path active
smtp.senha_ajuda: a password is already set; fill in only to change it
tarefas.ag_cron_ajuda: 5 fields: minute hour day month weekday (e.g. 30 3 * * *); minimum interval 15 min
tarefas.ag_erro_cron: the cron expression has 5 fields (minute hour day month weekday)
tarefas.ag_erro_fuso: unknown time zone (IANA name, e.g. America/Sao_Paulo)
tarefas.ag_erro_nome: a schedule with this name already exists
tarefas.ag_parametros_ajuda: JSON object with the type's parameters
tarefas.carregando_tarefa: reading the task and its log…
tarefas.erro_tipos: could not load the task types ({status}): {erro}
tarefas.log_nota: showing {n} of {total} lines; "download log" brings up to 2,000
tarefas.modo_polling: more than {n} active tasks: list refreshed every {s} s
tarefas.nao_encontrada: task not found (nonexistent, from another tenant or from another user)
tarefas.resumo: {pendente} queued · {rodando} running · {concluido} completed in 24 h · {falhou} failures in 24 h
tarefas.sessao_indisponivel: session data unavailable (GET /api/eu returned {status}); the screen continues with the tasks API
tarefas.vazio: no task yet; a task is born from an import, export, schedule or batch action
token.antigo_expira: the previous token remains valid until {quando}
token.escopos_ajuda: a scope without :<uuid> covers all layers; tenant administration only for the administrator profile
token.ip_ajuda: one per line, such as 10.0.0.0/8 or 203.0.113.7; empty = any IP
token.referer_ajuda: one per line, such as https://gis.example.gov or https://*.example.gov; empty = any origin
token.renovar_confirma: renew {nome}? A new token is created with the same scopes; the old one remains valid for 24 more hours.
token.revogar_confirma: revoke {nome}? Whoever uses it gets 401 on the next call.
token.uma_vez: the token is shown only once; copy it now.
tokens.rodape: the token is shown only once, at creation and renewal; revocation takes effect immediately
tokens.servicos_ajuda: QGIS, ArcGIS Pro/AGOL and OGC catalogues use these URLs with a service token; the required scope is shown next to each
upload.arquivo_pronto: the file is in storage and ready to become an import in /conteudo
upload.dropzone: drag the file here or click to choose
upload.dropzone_ajuda: several files at once; up to {tamanho} each, sent in {parte} parts with resume
upload.erro_preparar: could not prepare the upload (service token)
upload.erro_rede_parte: the network dropped while sending part {n}
upload.est_concluindo: finishing (verifying the content on the server)…
upload.parcial: {ok} uploaded, {falhas} failed; use 'try again' on the file's row
upload.tipo_ajuda: applies to files whose type was not recognized by the extension
upload.tipo_desconhecido: could not recognize the file type; choose one from the list
usuarios.buscar: search by login, name or e-mail
usuarios.desligar_2fa_confirma: turn off the second factor of {login}? Their sessions will be ended.
usuarios.redefinir_confirma: generate a temporary password for {login}? Their sessions will be ended and they change the password at first sign-in.
usuarios.rodape: recommendation: keep two active administrators; the password lockout also applies to administrators
usuarios.senha_temporaria_texto: temporary password of {login}; the user changes it at first sign-in.
usuarios.vazio: no member yet; create the first one or invite by e-mail
